scope: Shared tree/fruit layout and a single level-win settlement flow. No APK was built or installed.

layout.screenFit: Uniform full-canvas cover; no per-level fruit recentering or background-only safe-area stretching.
layout.animationEnvelope: Authored image pivot and idle position/scale curves, including extrema between keys.

settlement.flow: Level win -> existing reward host -> reward flow closes -> next level. No original WinUI opens.

verificationLimits: Unity compilation and saved-prefab transform checks plus isolated route/service tests and offline asset geometry. The changed version has not been packaged or tested on the physical phone. Existing unrelated working-tree edits were not included.
